title: Add VacationResponse object type (RFC 8621 §8)
description: RFC 8621 §8 defines VacationResponse as a singleton object type (one per account). It is entirely absent from jmap-mail-types. Fields: id (Id, server-set singleton id, always 'singleton'), isEnabled (bool), fromDate (UTCDate, optional), toDate (UTCDate, optional), subject (String, optional, null means server-generated), textBody (String, optional), htmlBody (String, optional). VacationResponse/get, /set are the supported methods.
design: Straightforward struct with #[non_exhaustive], PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize. The id field is always the string 'singleton' per RFC 8621 §8 but is still a regular Id field in the wire format. isEnabled defaults to false on creation per the spec.
